title: RHEM - Runtime Hard-Example Mining for Agent Systems
description: RHEM is a runtime hard-example mining reference implementation for Agent systems. Version 0.5.1 is a metadata-correction release for the expanded Agent-level hard-example mining whitepaper. It aligns the package, whitepaper, and archive version metadata after the initial v0.5.0 archive was generated from a release commit that still contained version 0.4.0 metadata. This is a documentation-focused release and does not claim production performance, statistical optimality, or proven generalization gains.
notes: RHEM v0.5.1 corrects the archive metadata for the expanded whitepaper. The first v0.5.0 archive is available as 10.5281/zenodo.22719697 but carries an unintended v0.4.0 version label. v0.4.0 remains available as 10.5281/zenodo.22719563; 10.5281/zenodo.22681163 is the concept DOI for the project.
